messages:
derek: Vendor Veneer wants to POC Kite-65B behind their VPC. Key asks: KMS, HIPAA, and SLA for p95 < 350ms. Need catalog-fit note and cost delta vs our 34B plan.
marta: Noted. Immediate checks: tokenizer and quant scheme. Also provenance/license for third-party weights.
ryan: Tokenizer first. If vocab differs we can add mapping but expect perf hit ~5-12%. Need artifact and tokenizer files.
tara: Infra: recommend 4xA100-80GB for steady throughput; 2xH100 for lower latency. Private deploy requires reserved capacity + network diagram.
ina: Security: vendor questionnaire, SHA256 artifact checksum, and signed DPA. For HIPAA confirm KMS audit logs + no external telemetry.
finance-bot: Back-of-envelope monthly committed delta: Dedicated 65B (~$XXk/month reserved) vs hosted premium (~$YYk/month). I will follow up with precise numbers.
derek: Action items: (1) Sales upload artifact + tokenizer + small eval set (2) Ryan run tokenizer/variant scan (3) Tara run A100/H100 perf baselines (4) Nina collect security docs (5) Finance to post ballpark. Quick sync 11:30 PT tomorrow? :thumbsup:
